shared_elements: standing anthropomorphic figure, frontal or profile, full length
bearded or beaked head in profile
patterned garment with hanging fringe or pleats
jewelry/ornament at the neck or belt
justification: Both depict a single upright anthropomorphic figure with a tall headdress and a patterned, fringed garment, which is a generic correspondence available to many traditions. The differences dominate: A is a strict profile human holding a long vertical spear with a naturalistic beard and pleated robe rendered in fine incised line, while B is a frontal bird-headed hybrid with two great outspread feathered wings, a serpentine arch overhead and flat outlined-and-filled decorative panels, with no shared relationship such as holding, flanking or facing.
